chunks: Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith عليه السلام was asked: Should musk and incense be brought near the deceased?

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الثَّالِثُ: Abu al-Hasan the Third, referring to Imam al-Hadi عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to bring musk and incense near a deceased person in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith عليه السلام permitting musk and incense to be brought near the deceased. It relates to etiquettes and rulings connected to handling the dead in Shia fiqh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.424 - Abu Al-Hasan al-Thalith, Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi (as) was asked whether musk and incense (bukhoor) should be brought near the deceased.
